title: Constraints
description: An owner's private limits for its agent, kept by the host and never sent to a counterparty. Inside them the agent acts alone. Outside an allowance the host escalates to the owner. A deny rule or a step set to off refuses outright. Anything missing defaults to the safe side: every step that can bind the owner (list, negotiate, accept, execute, amend, settle, share) asks; only revoke is auto. With no budget, any spend asks.

budget.description: Caps on money the owner pays. A deal that would cross one escalates with over_budget. Pay per click or per conversion counts at its cap; with no cap it always escalates.

max_rate_bps.description: Highest share of a sale the agent may promise alone. A share is paid out of the sale, so it does not count toward the cash caps. Unset: any share escalates with over_budget.

approve_over.description: A person approves any single deal worth more than this (over_threshold), in either direction.

kinds.description: Deal kinds the agent may do alone. Others escalate (kind_outside).

min_reputation.description: Below this, or with no score yet, escalate (low_reputation).

new.description: What to do with a first deal with a counterparty: auto, ask (new_counterparty) or off.

brand.description: Hard content rules. Terms that break them are refused with brand_rule, never escalated.
